what: Sparse Numeric Vector Class and Operations
title: Sparse Numeric Vector Class and Operations
text: sparseNumeric provides S4 class sparse numeric vectors set operations work directly sparse form, avoiding materializing large dense vectors full zeros.

title: Sparse Numeric Vector Class and Operations
Sparse Numeric Vector Class and Operations
text: basic example shows solve common problem:
code: library(sparseNumeric)  x_dense <- c(0, 0, 3, 0, -2) y_dense <- c(1, 0, 0, 4, 0)  x <- as(x_dense, "sparse_numeric") y <- as(y_dense, "sparse_numeric")  ## Sparse arithmetic x + y  ## Sparse dot product sparse_crossprod(x, y)  ## Euclidean norm norm(x)  ## Standardization s_std <- standardize(x) as(s_std, "numeric")
